lines.en: Osako, who must now distract herself from the idea of being tied up and teased by her girlfriend later tonight, exits the apartment by my side and leads me down the stairs.
lines.zh: Osako——此刻必须把「今晚稍后会被女友绑起来调情」的念头从脑中赶出去——与我并肩走出公寓,领着我下了楼。

lines.en: Just like she said, it’s not a far walk as I can already make out the light of the convenience store from around the corner.
lines.zh: 正如她所说,路并不远——转过街角,我已经能望见便利店的光了。
: 所以……

lines.en: : Can’t really say I expected to find myself out with you of all people on my anniversary.
lines.zh: : 说实话,真没想到纪念日这天,陪在外面的会是你这么一号人。

lines.en: : Hey, you’re the one who invited me. I was more than willing to go home.
lines.zh: : 嘿,是你邀请的我。我可是巴不得回家。

lines.en: : I know, I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道,我知道。

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : It’s the first time Wakana’s ever gone out of her way to contact anyone who isn’t me, I think.
lines.zh: : 我想,这是 Wakana 有生以来第一次主动去联系一个不是我的人。

lines.en: : Normally she’s just all like-
lines.zh: : 平时她只会一副——

lines.en: : Why would I expel the energy necessary to call someone when I have absolutely nothing to gain from doing so?
lines.zh: : 「打电话这件事要耗费的精力那么多,而我从中又绝对捞不到任何好处,我为什么要打?」

lines.en: : Wakana would say that? No way.
lines.zh: : Wakana 会说那种话?不会吧。

lines.en: : That’s impossible.
lines.zh: : 不可能。

lines.en: : It was just a little weird, you know?
lines.zh: : 就是有点怪,你懂吗?

lines.en: : Like, I’m glad that she finally has a friend and whatnot, but it’s just..uncharted territory, I guess.
lines.zh: : 就是说,她总算有了个朋友,我挺高兴的,但这只是……一片未知领域,我猜。

lines.en: : We’re not particularly close or anything, if that’s what you’re worried about.
lines.zh: : 要是你担心的是那个——我们并没有特别亲近。

lines.en: : I normally wait until a person’s significant other is in space before I think about making a move on them.
lines.zh: : 一般来说,我得等一个人的伴侣上了太空,才会考虑对其出手。

lines.en: : And even then it’s a sort of case by case basis.
lines.zh: : 而且即便到那一步,也要看具体情况。

lines.en: : Is that supposed to make me feel more comfortable about this?
lines.zh: : 你是想让我对这事更安心一点吗?

lines.en: : If you’re uncomfortable as it stands, isn’t that on you in the first place?
lines.zh: : 要是按现状你已经不自在,那不首先是你自己的问题?

lines.en: : Of course it is. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 当然是我的问题。只是……

lines.en: : I’m totally in love with Wakana and, despite her tendency to repeat the same thing over and over and over, she’s always been a little unpredictable.
lines.zh: : 我彻底爱着 Wakana。虽然她有着把同一句话翻来覆去、翻来覆去、再翻来覆去说的毛病,但她始终有点难以预料。

lines.en: : Like she doesn’t completely understand how other peoples’ feelings work. Myself included.
lines.zh: : 就像她并不完全理解别人的感受是怎么运作的。连我的也一样。

lines.en: : But she tries for me, at least. And I love that about her just like I love everything else.
lines.zh: : 但至少,她愿意为我努力。我爱她这一点,一如我爱她的一切。

lines.en: : Shit, what am I even saying right now? You don’t want to hear about this.
lines.zh: : 操,我现在都在说什么?这种事你不想听。

lines.en: : I don’t...not want to hear about it either.
lines.zh: : 我也……不是不想听。

lines.en: : You said you had something to talk to me about, so I figured through context clues that it would just be you ranting about how much you love goth girls for a few minutes or something.
lines.zh: : 你说你有点事想找我聊,所以我从上下文线索推断,大概就是你要花几分钟咆哮一下你有多爱哥特女孩之类的。

lines.en: : Not just any goth girls, dick. Wakana specifically.
lines.zh: : 不是随便什么哥特女孩,蠢货。是 Wakana,特指。

lines.en: : Frankly, I’m still surprised she even settled for me in the first place considering that my style is essentially the polar opposite of hers.
lines.zh: : 坦白讲,直到现在我还惊讶她当初居然会看上我——考虑到我的风格基本上是她的彻底反面。

lines.en: : You’re both cute in your own ways.
lines.zh: : 你们俩都有自己可爱的方式。

lines.en: : Stop calling me cute or I’ll break your kneecaps.
lines.zh: : 再叫我可爱一句,我就敲碎你的膝盖骨。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : Can I still call your girlfriend cute, though? Or is that off limits too?
lines.zh: : 那我还能夸你女朋友可爱吗?还是那也在禁区里?

lines.en: : You can call her whatever you want so long as you don’t try to make any actual moves on her.
lines.zh: : 你想叫她什么都行,只要别试图对她来任何真格的。

lines.en: : You’re not afraid she’d actually go along with it, are you? Because she clearly likes you a lot if she’s going to ask people for help just to try and cook something for you.
lines.zh: : 你不会是怕她真会顺杆爬吧?毕竟她为了给你做顿饭,肯去求人帮忙,可见她分明很喜欢你。

lines.en: : I like to think that too.
lines.zh: : 我也愿意这么想。

lines.en: : But...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 可是……我不知道。

lines.en: : Even though we tell each other we love one another all the time, she still feels weirdly distant on occasion.
lines.zh: : 尽管我们天天互相说爱,她有时候还是给我一种说不出的疏离感。

lines.en: : And, it’s probably self-explanatory due to the whole karate thing, but I have a tendency to be a little...defensive, I guess.
lines.zh: : 还有,考虑到空手道这档子事,这大概不言自明——我这个人有点……防御过度,我猜。

lines.en: : Not just with myself but with anything I want to protect.
lines.zh: : 不只是对我自己,对任何我想保护的东西都一样。

lines.en: : And I swore back in college that I’d protect her for the rest of my life, even if she didn’t want me to.
lines.zh: : 大学时我发过誓,这辈子都要保护她,哪怕她并不想要我这么做。

lines.en: : So, if she never accepted your confession, you’d just...stalk her every hour of every day and defend her from anyone who tried to get close?
lines.zh: : 所以说,如果她当时没接受你的表白,你就会……每天每小时地跟踪她,替她挡开任何试图靠近的人?

lines.en: : Yeah...probably...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概……我不知道。

lines.en: : Well, that’s not creepy at all.
lines.zh: : 哦,这可一点都不变态。

lines.en: : I can’t help it, okay?!
lines.zh: : 我控制不住,行吗?!

lines.en: : Wakana’s not like a normal person! She’s like a...scared little puppy that you need to be really gentle and careful with if you ever want her to warm up to you!
lines.zh: : Wakana 不像个正常人!她像一只……受惊的小狗,你要想让她对你敞开心扉,就得极其温柔、极其小心!

lines.en: : I mean, I never had to do that.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛,我可从来没用过那套。

lines.en: : That’s...exactly why I feel so weird about all of this.
lines.zh: : 这……恰恰就是这一切让我感觉如此古怪的原因。

lines.en: : And a big part of why I wanted to talk to you.
lines.zh: : 也是我想找你聊的一大原因。

lines.en: : For some reason, Wakana warmed up to you almost right away.
lines.zh: : 不知为什么,Wakana 几乎立刻就对你敞开了心扉。

lines.en: : Way quicker than she did with me and the two of us are in an actual relationship now.
lines.zh: : 比对我快得多,而我们现在可是实实在在的恋人关系。

lines.en: : So I can’t help but overthink that since it’s just...a brand new thing I’ve never had to deal with.
lines.zh: : 所以我忍不住想东想西,因为这只是……一件我从未应对过的全新事物。

lines.en: : I’m not going to steal your girlfriend, Osako.
lines.zh: : 我不会抢走你的女朋友的,Osako。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概不会。

lines.en: Especially since I’d likely die the second I tried anything.
lines.zh: 尤其是,我真要对她们做什么,大概率当场就会死。

lines.en: : It’s not just the actual act of you “stealing” her. It’s a...fear I have that maybe she’ll realize that she wants something else.
lines.zh: : 不只是你真的去「抢」她这种事。这是一种……恐惧,怕她也许会意识到,她想要的其实是别的东西。

lines.en: : And that we’ll revert to being friends or something if she starts thinking that things aren’t as good as they could be with a different person.
lines.zh: : 怕她一旦开始觉得,换个人也许会更幸福,我们就会退回到朋友,或者别的什么关系。

lines.en: : I’m going to be honest, you were the last person I thought I’d have to coach some self-esteem back into.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我最没想到要给回输一点自尊心的人,会是你。

lines.en: : I’m going to be honest too and say that you’re the last person I thought I’d ever have to talk to about this.
lines.zh: : 我也说实话:我最没想到会跟这个人聊这种事的人,也是你。

lines.en: : Just being strong physically doesn’t make me strong as a person, you know. I’m actually annoyingly sensitive when it comes to stuff like this.
lines.zh: : 光是身体强壮,不代表我这个人就强壮,你知道吧。这种事情上,我其实敏感得让人烦。

lines.en: : Wakana’s the tough one. But I think a lot of that is just because she doesn’t really see the world the same way most other people do.
lines.zh: : 难对付的是 Wakana。不过我想,那多半只是因为她看这个世界的眼光,和其他大多数人不太一样。

lines.en: We’ve already made it to the convenience store, but have yet to set foot inside and disturb the employees with our decently personal conversation.
lines.zh: 我们已经走到了便利店门口,但还没踏进去、用我们这番相当私人的对话去打扰店员们。

lines.en: A conversation I had a feeling was going to be inevitable from the moment I got Wakana’s phone number.
lines.zh: 从我拿到 Wakana 电话号码的那一刻起,我就有种预感:这场对话终归躲不掉。

lines.en: I’m not entirely used to engaging in relationships with people whose significant others are not missing, so at least I can be glad this is happening now rather than later.
lines.zh: 和人打交道时,我还不太习惯对方的伴侣并不下落不明的情况,所以至少我可以庆幸,这一切发生在现在而不是以后。

lines.en: Preferably, I’d like if it wouldn’t happen at all.
lines.zh: 更理想的话,我希望它干脆别发生。

lines.en: But not even my life can be as convenient as that.
lines.zh: 但连我的人生,也没便利到那份上。

lines.en: : I have a question for you.
lines.zh: : 我有个问题想问你。

lines.en: : You do? About Wakana?
lines.zh: : 是吗?关于 Wakana?

lines.en: : More or less.
lines.zh: : 差不多。

lines.en: : My question is...if you really do care about her, shouldn’t you want her to figure out whether what she truly wants is you or not?
lines.zh: : 我的问题是……如果你真的在乎她,难道你不应该希望她去弄清楚,她真正想要的到底是不是你吗?

lines.en: : I do. But that doesn’t mean I’m not going to worry about it as well.
lines.zh: : 我是应该。但这不代表我就不会为此担心。

lines.en: : She’s everything to me. And the thought of that changing is just...
lines.zh: : 她就是我的一切。而想到这一切会变,就只是……

lines.en: : Let me clarify that I don’t think you need to worry about that.
lines.zh: : 让我说明白:我觉得你不需要为此担心。

lines.en: : I haven’t known Wakana for long, but the things she said about you today made me realize that she’s so into you that she wouldn’t even consider romance with someone else.
lines.zh: : 我认识 Wakana 不算久,但她今天说的那些关于你的话,让我意识到她迷你迷到连和别人谈恋爱的念头都不会有。

lines.en: : Consideration doesn’t really have anything to do with it.
lines.zh: : 这和「念头」什么的没什么关系。

lines.en: : Wakana’s not as...calculated as she might make it seem. She’s actually pretty neurotic and impulsive at times.
lines.zh: : Wakana 不像她表现出来的那么……精于算计。她其实相当神经质,有时候还冲动。

lines.en: : She can think one thing but then do something else. And things like that aren’t always easy to suppress, which is why I’ve always kept a close eye on her.
lines.zh: : 她可能心里想的是一回事,做出来的是另一回事。而那种东西并不总压得住,所以我才一直把她盯得紧紧的。

lines.en: : Well...I kept a close eye on her even before I knew that because...holy shit, she’s so hot.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……在知道这些之前,我就把她盯得紧紧的了,因为……我的天,她实在太辣了。

lines.en: : But yeah.
lines.zh: : 不过,对。

lines.en: : I guess I just think everything right now is a little too good to be true.
lines.zh: : 我猜我只是觉得,眼下的一切都有点好得不真实。

lines.en: : And that one day she’ll snap out of what’s been such a happy dream for me and move onto bigger and better things.
lines.zh: : 总有一天,她会从我这场美梦里猛然醒来,奔向更广阔、更美好的事物。

lines.en: : I don't know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Sorry for springing this on you out of nowhere. I’m just really afraid of losing her and...I guess I wanted you to know that?
lines.zh: : 抱歉突然把这种事砸给你。我只是真的很怕失去她,而且……我想让你知道这个?

lines.en: : Why are you wording that like a question?
lines.zh: : 你为什么把话说得像个问句?

lines.en: : Probably because I still don’t understand why I wanted you to know that when you’re already fucking Ayane.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为,你都已经和 Ayane 做了,我还是搞不懂自己为什么要让你知道这个。

lines.en: : I’m-
: You totally are.
lines.zh: : 你绝对是。

lines.en: : You don’t-
lines.zh: : 你才不——

lines.en: : Don’t even try to deny it. It’s so obvious.
lines.zh: : 别想否认。太明显了。

lines.en: Damnit, Ayane.
lines.zh: 该死,Ayane。

lines.en: Why must your love for me be so powerful?
lines.zh: 你的爱为什么非得这么强烈?

lines.en: : I’m also a little mad that you got to see Wakana in an apron. I wanted that to just be a me thing.
lines.zh: : 还有一点让我小气不顺:看到 Wakana 穿围裙的居然有你。我本来想让那成为我一个人的风景。

lines.en: : She looked surprisingly...homely for a woman who would likely have trouble microwaving instant ramen.
lines.zh: : 她看起来出奇地……贤惠居家——对一个连加热杯面都多半会出问题的女人来说。

lines.en: : And on that note, we should probably head inside so we’re not out here looking like we actually enjoy each other’s company.
lines.zh: : 说到这里,我们该进去了,别在外面站得像真的享受彼此的陪伴似的。

lines.en: : Wait...are both of you tsundere?
lines.zh: : 等等……你们俩都是傲娇吗?

lines.en: : Hm? Wakana, maybe a little bit.
lines.zh: : 嗯?Wakana 吧,也许有一点。

lines.en: : But you’d absolutely know if I had any feelings for you. I make very little effort to actually hide them.
lines.zh: : 但我要是对你有点什么,你绝对会知道。我可几乎不费心去藏。

lines.en: : This hurts me.
lines.zh: : 这话伤到我了。

lines.en: : Well, sorry to hurt ya even more, but that weird banana shaped muscle you’re already sharing with Ayane would be a no-go for me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 好吧,抱歉要伤你更深了——你那根形状怪异、已经和 Ayane 共用的香蕉形肌肉,对我来说本来就是不行。

lines.en: : So it’s not just me, it’s men in general.
lines.zh: : 所以不是针对我,是对男人整体。

lines.en: : That somehow makes me feel a little bit better.
lines.zh: : 不知为何,这让我好受了一点点。

lines.en: : It’s also kinda you.
lines.zh: : 也有点是因为你。

lines.en: : You’re fine to talk to...but even if I did like dudes, you're too much of a wimp.
lines.zh: : 和你聊天倒还行……但就算我喜欢男人,你也太怂了。

lines.en: : Okay, time to shop.
lines.zh: : 好,该采购了。

lines.en: Osako and I enter the convenience store and I can immediately tell just how often she does this.
lines.zh: Osako 和我走进便利店,我立刻就能看出这种事她做得有多频繁。

lines.en: She moves through the narrow aisles with surgical precision, placing ingredients neatly into a basket that she grabbed just beyond the store’s automatic doors.
lines.zh: 她以外科手术般的精准穿行于狭窄的过道,把食材齐整地放进一只购物篮——那只篮子是她刚过自动门时就抄起来的。

lines.en: There’s little to no conversation on the inside, which I imagine is due to the fact that we last left off on the...sheer concept of penises.
lines.zh: 店里几乎没说什么话,我想是因为,我们上次的话题正好停在……penis 这个纯粹的概念上。

lines.en: But, at the same time, I feel like Osako has already said everything she wanted to say in the first place.
lines.zh: 但与此同时,我感觉 Osako 想说的话,原本就已经说完了。

lines.en: She’s madly in love with Wakana Watabe. This much is entirely irrefutable.
lines.zh: 她疯狂地爱着 Wakana Watabe。这一点毫无辩驳余地。

lines.en: In fact, even if the two of them wound up breaking up, I can see Osako sitting quietly on a porch somewhere, growing old and withering away while thoughts of Wakana still dance around in her head.
lines.zh: 实际上,就算她们两个最终分手,我也能想象 Osako 安静地坐在某处檐廊上,慢慢老去、慢慢枯萎,而关于 Wakana 的思绪仍在她脑中起舞。

lines.en: I wonder if I’ll ever be able to feel that way about anyone.
lines.zh: 我不知道,我对任何人是否也能产生那样的感情。

lines.en: And then I think about all of the people who feel that way about me.
lines.zh: 然后我想到了所有对我抱有那种感情的人。

lines.en: It ruins my night.
lines.zh: 这毁掉了我的夜晚。

lines.en: : Okay! Now we’re ready to make actual soup that isn’t filled with Jell-O.
lines.zh: : 好!现在我们可以煮真正的汤了,不再是灌满果冻的那种。

lines.en: : Oh, am I coming back with you?
lines.zh: : 哦,我要跟你一起回去吗?

lines.en: : Nope! By “we” I meant Wakana and I.
lines.zh: : 不!我说的「我们」,是 Wakana 和 I。

lines.en: : Wakana and me.
lines.zh: : 是 Wakana 和 me。

lines.en: : Fuck off. Only Wakana can correct I.
lines.zh: : 滚。只有 Wakana 才能纠正 I。

lines.en: : Now you’re just fucking with me on purpose.
lines.zh: : 你现在就是纯粹在耍我。

lines.en: : Damn right me am.
lines.zh: : 被 me 说中了。

lines.en: : Thank you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,谢谢你。

lines.en: : Not just for hearing me out, but for being a friend to the girl I love more than anything else in the world.
lines.zh: : 不只是听我倾诉,还为了做那个女孩的朋友——我爱她胜过世上的一切。

lines.en: : And remember...if you do try anything, I know of seven different pressure points on your body that could kill you instantaneously.
lines.zh: : 还有,记住……你要是敢来真的,我知道你身上七个不同的要害,任何一个都能让你瞬间毙命。

lines.en: : There is no way that’s true.
lines.zh: : 那绝对不可能是真的。

lines.en: : Play your cards right and you’ll never have the displeasure of finding out!
lines.zh: : 只要你好好表现,就永远不必体验核实它的不快!

lines.en: : It’s terrifying how you can smile like that while threatening to kill me.
lines.zh: : 你能一边威胁杀我一边露出那种笑容,太可怕了。

lines.en: : If it’s to protect my cute little fallen angel, I can do anything.
lines.zh: : 只要是为了保护我可爱的小堕落天使,我什么都做得出来。

lines.en: : You mean anything except feeling totally comfortable with her associating with someone of the opposite sex because you’re afraid she’ll suddenly discover how awesome she thinks penises are.
lines.zh: : 你说的「什么都做得出来」,不包括坦然接受她与异性交往——因为你怕她会突然发现,penis 在她眼里有多么了不起。

lines.en: : Okay, now you’re just being an asshole.
lines.zh: : 好了,你现在是纯粹在当混蛋了。

lines.en: : I’m always an asshole. You just don’t have enough experience with me to realize that.
lines.zh: : 我一直是混蛋。只是你和我的交情还不够,意识不到这一点。

lines.en: : I have even more experience with you than Wakana does. I’ve been giving you karate lessons for like...I don’t even know how long now.
lines.zh: : 我和你的交情比 Wakana 还深。我给你上空手道课都上了……我自己都不知道多久了。

lines.en: : Correction- you’ve been trying to give me karate lessons.
lines.zh: : 更正——是你一直「试图」给我上空手道课。

lines.en: : You have yet to succeed.
lines.zh: : 而你至今没有成功过。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Looks like I might have to try a little harder next time, then.
lines.zh: : 哦是吗?那看来下次我得多上点心了。

lines.en: : Hope you’re ready to feel sore all over for the next year.
lines.zh: : 希望你准备好接下来一整年浑身酸痛。

lines.en: : What are you going to do to me?
lines.zh: : 你要对我做什么?

lines.en: : Hm. Maybe reveal one of those seven pressure points?
lines.zh: : 嗯。也许演示一下那七个要害中的一个?

lines.en: : If I delete Wakana’s number from my phone, will you allow me to keep my life?
lines.zh: : 要是我把 Wakana 的号码从手机里删掉,你能饶我一命吗?

lines.en: : You don’t have to stop talking to her or anything, dude.
lines.zh: : 用不着你跟她断绝来往什么的,伙计。

lines.en: : Just...keep in mind that she’s everything to me. And that without her I’d be absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: : 只是……记住她是我的一切。记住没有她,我什么都不是。

lines.en: : Sounds good.
lines.zh: : 没问题。

lines.en: : Anyway, enjoy getting tied up and edged tonight.
lines.zh: : 总之,祝你今晚被绑起来、被吊在边缘玩得尽兴。

lines.en: : I will, thank you very much!
lines.zh: : 我会的,多谢关心!

lines.en: : And I hope you enjoy sexting one of your students!
lines.zh: : 也祝你给你的某个学生发色情短信发得开心!

lines.en: : I don’t really do that. I much prefer actual physical-
lines.zh: : 我其实不怎么干那个。我更喜欢实际的肢——

lines.en: : Die!
lines.zh: : 去死!

lines.en: : I mean...bye!
lines.zh: : 我是说……拜拜!

lines.en: : Go away!
lines.zh: : 滚开!

lines.en: Osako storms off in the opposite direction with a shopping bag pressed firmly between a set of fingers that will likely wind up inside a coworker of mine tonight.
lines.zh: Osako 气冲冲地朝反方向走去,购物袋被紧紧夹在五根手指之间——而今晚,这五根手指大概率会出现在我的某位同事体内。

lines.en: I contemplate whether or not this “sexting” thing is truly worth it-
lines.zh: 我琢磨着这种「色情短信」到底值不值当——

lines.en: But then realize that I have a perfectly good lesbian fantasy to continue playing out in my head as soon as I get home.
lines.zh: 随即意识到,一回家,我脑内还有一场完好的蕾丝边幻想等着继续上演。

lines.en: Osako’s affection has increased to [osako_love]!
lines.zh: Osako 的好感度提升到了 [osako_love]!
